Lineicons (Basic / free set)
https://lineicons.com — https://github.com/LineiconsHQ/Lineicons

Only the individual icons used by this application are vendored here, embedded
in the product rather than redistributed as an icon pack. Each file has been
normalised: the hardcoded brand hex was replaced with `currentColor` and the
fixed pixel width/height attributes were removed so the stylesheet controls
size and colour. The path data is unmodified.
